{{recipesummary|category=Squash recipes|servings=2|time=45 minutes|difficulty=2}}{{recipe}}

'''Acorn squash with orange marmalade''' is a quick, easy vegetable side dish that has great appeal due to its slight sweetness.

==Ingredients==
*1 medium [[Cookbook:Acorn Squash|acorn squash]], halved lengthwise
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Marmalade|orange marmalade]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
*⅛ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

==Procedure==
#Preheat oven to 400°F (204°C). 
#Remove seeds and strings from squash halves. 
#Cut a small piece off outside of each half to make a flat space on which the half can stand level. 
#Place halves in a shallow pan or casserole in ¼ inch (6 mm) water with insides facing down. Bake for 35 minutes.
#Combine marmalade and butter in a small bowl. 
#Remove squash from oven, and invert in pan or dish. Salt lightly.
#Spread marmalade and butter mixture on edges of squash, allowing excess to run into center. 
#Place under broiler for 5 minutes or until lightly browned.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* Substitute [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]] for the orange marmalade.
